$comment: ADR-060 §3.5 + ADR-061 H2 — the UNIFIED trust vocabulary for the whole ecosystem. Grant decided (2026-07-13) to canonicalize on the EI_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.v1 band names (Platinum/Gold/Standard/Watch/Untrusted), NOT ADR-060's original SANDBOX/USER/TRUSTED/OWNER. Source of truth for the bands + thresholds: EI_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.v1.md (FROZEN, vendored verbatim in the four cloud cells). This file pins how that vocabulary drives the agent-control tier algebra + the deprecated ADR-060 aliases for transition. Additive → v1.1 via PR; breaking → v2 and tell Grant.
source_of_truth: EI_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.v1 (windy-cloud cells contracts/) — the canonical band definitions, thresholds, velocity multipliers, and fraud-hold rules. This file governs only the agent-control tier × band interaction.

invariants.$comment: No band, no autonomy level, no combination overrides these.
invariants.always_confirm_floor: Tools tiered always_confirm (money actions, apply_update, reset_to_defaults, run_shell, publish) confirm on EVERY invocation for EVERY band — Platinum included. No band buys silent spending (EI_CAPABILITY_MATRIX 'Hard line'). Consent governed by CONFIRM_FLOW.v1.
invariants.no_self_escalation: A standing grant is given by the USER via the confirmer; an agent can never grant itself one.
invariants.structured_denial: A denial returns {ok:false, error:'denied'} — never silence. Untrusted: denied + owner notified.
invariants.discovery_filtering: A caller below a tool's band_floor never sees the tool in tools/list — gating starts at discovery, not invocation.
invariants.fail_safe: EI lookup failure → treat as Watch for writes, Standard for reads (fail-safe, not fail-open).

tiers.always_confirm: confirm per call — yes, even Platinum

bands.note: repair-own capability class unlocks at Gold+.

tiers.ask_first: confirm per call; user MAY grant a session always-allow

bands.adr060_alias: (none — a middle tier ADR-060's 4-band scheme lacked)

tiers.always_confirm: confirm per call; mandatory fraud holds

capability_classes.$comment: The Fable-7.5 Doctrine rider — WHAT KIND of action, orthogonal to the EI band (which gates HOW MUCH). A manifest tool belongs to one class; band_floor gates within it.
capability_classes.act-own: normal operations on the caller's OWN resources.
capability_classes.repair-own: deep diagnostics/repair on the caller's OWN resources — unlocks at Gold+ (EI).
capability_classes.operator: runbook-as-tools on the OPS/healing control surface (restart/redeploy/logs). Gated by an OPERATOR-ROLE EPT claim (Windy staff / Kit agents), NOT by EI band — so an ops/healing tool is operator-class regardless of a caller's EI. This is the doctrine's ops surface (§3.6 'the doctor is not in the patient').

band_floor_defaults.$comment: Applied when a manifest tool omits band_floor. Named in the canonical EI-matrix vocabulary.

adr060_alias_map.$comment: Transition aliases (ADR-061 H2). Manifests may still use the deprecated ADR-060 names; the validator accepts both. Normalize to the EI-matrix names.

confirmation_transport.desktop: voice or tap via the product confirmer (windytalk hands/tiers.py pattern)
confirmation_transport.cloud: CONFIRM_FLOW.v1 — single-use HMAC tokens, voice-yes first-class, composite bundles = one yes
